assets.name: detcache_val_native
assets.purpose: VisDrone val-7 (V7 development sandbox): YOLOv8n, RT-DETR-L, Faster R-CNN detections at 736 + per-frame motion cues
assets.regenerable: yes, but NOT byte-identical (built on Mac MPS; a CUDA/CPU rebuild is a new baseline and V6/V7 numbers must be re-established on it)
assets.rebuild_command: per detector: python tools/cache_detections.py --weights <W> --dataset <VisDrone split> --output-dir outputs/det_cache_<split>_native/<det> --resolutions 736 [--nms 0.7 for yolov8n.pt | --nms 0.5 for Faster R-CNN | (RT-DETR ignores NMS)]; motion cues: python tools/visual_cues.py <dataset> outputs/det_cache_<split>_native (original recipe: tools/mac_cache_queue_v5tf.sh)
